title: Measuring Spiritual Values and Biases of Large Language Models
findings: Contrary to the hypothesis that LLMs are secular, the study found they exhibit diverse and often significant spiritual or religious inclinations. Models classified as more religious tended to perform better at detecting religion-targeted hate speech. Furthermore, further pre-training LLMs on spiritual texts (religious canons) was shown to mitigate biases and improve performance on humanistic tasks like hate speech detection.
